rationale: Complete contiguous metric weight panels with harmonic s-g auxiliary AOs contract each ordered auxiliary shell pair once: every harmonic AO is an exact top-order Hermite Gaussian combination, so the compiler-owned DF radial recurrence raised by one order contracts the projected symmetric weight block directly, and only the first center is differentiated. Same-atom pairs cancel exactly and are skipped. Partial/offset/strided/serial/distributed-sink panels, range separation, auxiliary h and Cartesian d and above keep the per-AO pair route. Explicit 0 rolls back to that route; PAIRS=0 still selects dense traversal; invalid controls reject.
revisit_condition: Extend to range-separated metrics only with an erf-attenuated radial oracle and to partial panels only with bounded ownership of both orientations. Keep arbitrary nonsymmetric weights, libcint int2c2e_ip1 and PySCF auxiliary-response gates and explicit rollback.
